CORRECTED_SAME_PASS: The branch call below is WRONG and branch A, not B, is the right reading. I computed R by dividing my revision distance by MY bf16 arm (full bf16, 0.02441) and compared it against of3t-trunkfwd's 46.67x, which was taken against ITS bf16 arm -- upstream's AUTOCAST bf16, 0.005985. the_finding_that_matters_more_than_the_b: WHICH REVISION YOU SCORE AGAINST OUTWEIGHS BF16 PRECISION BY 8.6x ON THE TRUNK'S PAIR TRACK. The campaign has spent most of its effort on numerical precision -- softmax accumulation, fp32 reductions, dtype per operand. One unflagged line at one call site in the reference is worth 8.6 times the entire bf16 error budget of the thing being measured. Reference provenance is not a footnote to a parity campaign; at this scope it is the larger term.

what_this_does_NOT_overturn: D90's withdrawal of the product-defect escalation was a CORRECTNESS argument from source -- our transpose_bias setting matches our preview2 checkpoint -- and it was never a magnitude argument. It stands. What this refutes is the sentence in THE_TRUNK_BIAS_IS_A_REVISION_DIFFERENCE that the 46.67x 'conflates a known revision difference': the revision difference is real and substantial but it is not that big.
